hints.title: Reverse Equivalence
hints.text: Pair words whose characters match in reverse order.

hints.title: Membership Lookup
hints.text: Track seen strings in a set; if the reversed string has been observed, form a pair.

hints.title: Single Pass Counting
hints.text: Increment the pair count on each match and do not insert already paired items.

hints.title: Set Match Implementation

complexity.notes: Each word has length 2, making string reversal O(1).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all pairs takes quadratic time when hash lookup is linear.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set tracks words seen in previous iterations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies complementary reversed pairs in a single linear pass.
